# library

**In one sentence:** the start screen: a searchable grid of project cards where you create, edit, duplicate, delete, and open projects.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `controller.js` | Loads the card list (`list_projects`), switches between the library and project views, opens a project, and runs the New / Edit / Duplicate / Delete actions. `bindLibraryEvents` wires the toolbar, search box, and sort select. |
| `view.js` | `renderLibrary()` filters cards by name, token, or input folder, sorts them (most recently changed first, or by name), draws each card with a status pill, adds a "New project" card, and enables footer buttons only when a card is selected. |
| `modal.js` | `openProjectModal({mode, project, onSaved})` — the New / Edit project form (name, input folder, output folder, Browse buttons); `confirmModal` — a generic yes/no dialog that resolves to `true` / `false`. |
| `library.css` | Library-only layout: toolbar, empty-search message, form, and the `draft` / `running` pill colours. |

## How it works
- On start, `core/app.js` calls `loadLibrary` with the already-fetched project list.
- Click a card to select it; double-click (or Open) calls `openProject`, which shows the shell view and loads the project.
- Picking an input folder with Browse fills the name (folder name) and a suggested output folder (`default_output`) unless the user already typed their own; Save calls `create_project` or `update_project`.
- Delete asks for confirmation; it removes the project config but keeps output data.
- "Back to library" in the project window switches views and reloads the cards.

## Who uses it
- `core/app.js` — `bindLibraryEvents`, `loadLibrary`, `showShellView`.
- Bridge methods: `list_projects`, `create_project`, `update_project`, `duplicate_project`, `delete_project`, `choose_folder`, `default_output`.
- Tests: none target this folder directly under `tests/ui/static/`.

## Good to know
- The card status (`completed`, `running`, `failed`, `draft`) comes from `project_status` in `runner/payloads.py`.
